note: The default workspace arrangement. No layout file, .ui file or saveState blob existed anywhere in the repo -- this arrangement was encoded only in dock_manager.py's addDockWidget/tabifyDockWidget/splitDockWidget calls, so it is recorded here.

docks.title: Log
docks.note: The title is 'Log' even though the class and module say 'Logging'.

docks.title: Charts
docks.note: Hidden by default (dock_chart.hide()): a chart's primary home is the Visualize stage page. The dock survives for pinned side-by-side comparisons.

docks.title: AI Assistant
docks.note: Stacked vertically below the chart dock, deliberately NOT tabbed with it.

layout_rationale: Console and Log are tabbed together: the one place a durable, scrollable record of everything that happened accumulates, versus the transient status bar.
Chart and Data Table share a tab strip (milestone 18): a chart and a data table are the same kind of thing -- a view onto one dataset's content -- so they do not each claim permanent screen space.
The AI Assistant is split vertically below Chart rather than tabbed, so a chart and an in-progress conversation can both stay visible at once.
Charts is hidden by default (milestone 20): its primary home is the Visualize stage page. Dataset Explorer and Console are raised initially.

The Project Explorer dock was DELETED, not hidden, in milestone 20: it never worked, and its one job (naming the open project) was absorbed as a top-level 'Project' node inside Dataset Explorer. Absence over inert placeholder.

NOTE: a stale comment in dock_manager.py (lines 182-185) says Chart is 'not tabbed with anything'. The code below it tabifies Chart with Data Table (milestone 18); the code is authoritative and is what is recorded above.
menu_notes: '-' is a separator. Menu order and grouping exist ONLY here: the surviving action registry (uadas_core/actions/builtin_actions.py) holds labels/shortcuts/icons but is unordered and has no notion of which menu an action belongs to.

Open Recent is built per-instance, not from the registry, because each item's target path is per-instance data no static ActionSpec can represent. Its cap of 10 lives in uadas_core/services/project_service.py (_MAX_RECENT_PROJECTS).
Every menu's aboutToShow re-requests an enablement refresh: a lazy safety net so a forgotten call site degrades to stale-until-next-interaction, not permanently wrong.

The Edit menu was REMOVED in milestone 17, not merely emptied: Undo/Redo were clickable actions connected to nothing. It returned in milestone 23 once real undo existed. Standing rule: absence over an inert placeholder -- never ship a greyed-out stub.
action_handlers_note: These 15 are bound by MainWindow. The 9 workbench.go_to_<stage> stage-navigation actions in the registry (every PipelineStage except UPLOAD, which has no page) are bound by GuidanceController, so they are intentionally absent from this table.
action_handlers_rule: assert_all_bound(): no registered action may be left without a handler -- a startup-time hard failure, the fix for real dead menu items.

command_palette.population: every spec with palette_visible=True, sorted by label; status_tip is the row tooltip
command_palette.disabled_actions_rationale: so the palette answers 'what can this application do', not only 'what can I do right now' -- useful for discovery; selecting a disabled one is a safe no-op
command_palette.filter: case-insensitive substring over f'{label} {action_id}' -- action ids are searchable, not just labels; selection auto-moves to the first visible row

keys.Up/Down: forwarded to the list while focus stays in the search field (so 'type to filter, arrow to pick' works without tabbing)

command_palette.on_open: refresh enablement, clear the search, repopulate, focus the search field
